reason.description: Optional reason. Do not record health information or diagnosis (RNF-13).

role.description: Role to assign to the invited person. SUPERADMIN is not allowed.

url.description: Full URL for the invite page. Includes the plain-text token — share with care.

contents.description: Contents of the lesson plan, in the order they are taught. At least one.

expectedDurationMinutes.description: Expected duration in minutes. It counts toward the workload of the courses.

objective.description: Null or empty means not informed.

person.description: Account owner. Only on password_reset invites; always null on access invites.

archivedAt.description: Null while the lesson plan is active (RN-27).
